io.github.kirstenali.deepj.tensor.PackedMatmulShape
public record PackedMatmulShape(int leftRows, int rightRows, int rows, int cols, int inner, boolean transposeLeft, boolean transposeRight) extends Record
Logical dimensions for the compatibility API; never inferred from a GPU allocation's physical rows.
